summary: Iteration 45 validated the P0 request: mount SemanticIntelligencePanel (recursive deobfuscation + Behavior Storyline) on /workspace and achieve parity with /auto-investigate for the octal ASCII acceptance payload. WORKSPACE (/) PASSES ALL 7 acceptance criteria for the octal payload: (a) [data-testid=workspace-semantic-intelligence] renders after AUTO INVESTIGATE; (b) semantic-v2-deob-0 shows EXACTLY 2 recursive stages — stage 1 = 'Resolve .NET string format' (matches 'format'), stage 2 = 'Octal ASCII reconstruction'; (c) semantic-v2-deob-final-0 contains "Write-Host 'Hello, from PowerShell!'"; (d) semantic-v2-deob-boundary-0 references Invoke-Expression; (e) semantic-v2-story-0 renders Executive Summary + 8 per-category tiles with observed/not-observed badges + MITRE roll-up containing T1027 and T1027.010 + Attack Narrative; (f) semantic-v2-deob-toggle-0-0 expands and shows before (octal ints '127,162,151,164,...') / after ('Write-Host ...') panels without React errors; (g) CLEAR button correctly removes workspace-semantic-intelligence from DOM. REGRESSION on base64 -EncodedCommand payload on /workspace: workspace-semantic-intelligence + semantic-v2-story-0 still surface (backwards-compat OK); 0 deob stages is expected (base64 path doesn't need recursive deob). AUTO-INVESTIGATE tab (/auto-investigate) FAILS parity: pasting the same octal payload runs the incident-telemetry pipeline which produces 'Insufficient telemetry' and NEVER emits any semantic-v2-* testid — chain.semantic is empty. Curl to /api/decode/smart with the acceptance payload returns semantic.deobfuscation.stages=['Resolve .NET string format','Octal ASCII reconstruction'] and boundary_op='Invoke-Expression' (backend verified). Zero page/console errors on Workspace flow.

integration_issues.flow: /auto-investigate → AUTO INVESTIGATE with naked PowerShell octal payload
integration_issues.issue: Semantic Intelligence panel does NOT render on /auto-investigate for the acceptance payload. The Auto-Investigate pipeline treats the raw script as incident-telemetry text and renders 'Insufficient telemetry / Suspicious endpoint activity' instead of decoding it via /decode/smart (or the chain returned by the auto-investigate endpoint has an empty chain.semantic). No semantic-v2-* testids appear even after 40s wait. This breaks acceptance criterion #3 of the review request: 'On the AUTO INVESTIGATE tab, run the same payload. semantic-v2-deob-0 and semantic-v2-story-0 should render with functionally identical content to /workspace'. Iteration 44 reported this WAS working on /auto-investigate for the same octal payload, so this is a regression window between iter44 and iter45 — likely the auto-investigate backend route stopped propagating semantic.deobfuscation into chain.semantic, or its input classifier now routes naked PS scripts to the incident-telemetry branch instead of the decode branch. Backend /api/decode/smart is confirmed correct via curl; the fix likely lives in whatever endpoint AutoInvestigatePage calls (probably /api/auto-investigate/run or similar) — ensure it also invokes ps_semantic.analyze and stuffs it into each chain.semantic so <SemanticIntelligencePanel semantic={chain.semantic}/> at AutoInvestigatePage.jsx:1608 has data.

action_items: Wire the /auto-investigate backend chain response to include chain.semantic populated from ps_semantic.analyze() (or route the input through /decode/smart when it detects a naked PowerShell script). Once fixed, semantic-v2-deob-0 and semantic-v2-story-0 will appear on the AUTO INVESTIGATE tab for the acceptance payload and reach parity with /workspace.
critical_code_review_comments: WorkspacePage.jsx has grown well past the 700-line soft cap (now >1760 lines) — the semantic wiring lives in three separate handlers (revertToFlatDecode, autoInvestigate, nivxrayDecode) that each duplicate `setSemantic(r.data.semantic || null)`. Extract a `useDecodeSmart` hook that owns the semantic state and returns a single setter, and split the page into <WorkspaceInput/>, <WorkspaceActions/>, <WorkspaceResults/> subcomponents.

AutoInvestigatePage.jsx passes chain.semantic to SemanticIntelligencePanel but the /auto-investigate backend endpoint is apparently no longer populating that field for naked PS scripts — this is a silent contract break between backend and frontend. Add a Pydantic response schema (ChainResult) with `semantic: Optional[SemanticV2]` and enforce it in tests to prevent this class of regression.

The acceptance payload result on /workspace shows initial_execution=NOT observed even though the script contains Invoke-Expression $out and the boundary_op is Invoke-Expression. The storyline heuristic seems to treat Invoke-Expression as 'deobfuscation boundary' only, not as an execution flag. Consider having initial_execution=observed whenever boundary_op is a known execution primitive (Invoke-Expression, iex, .Invoke(), &, IEX).

rca of the issue: Parity failure RCA: WorkspacePage now calls /api/decode/smart in autoInvestigate() and stuffs r.data.semantic into local state → panel renders. AutoInvestigatePage renders <SemanticIntelligencePanel semantic={chain.semantic}/> for each chain returned by the auto-investigate endpoint, but that endpoint currently returns chain.semantic = null/undefined for the naked-PS acceptance payload (or routes the input to the incident-telemetry summariser which produces no chain at all — the page shows 'Insufficient telemetry'). Reproduction: login → /auto-investigate → paste the exact acceptance payload → click AUTO INVESTIGATE → observe zero elements matching [data-testid^=semantic-v2-]. Backend /api/decode/smart returns the full semantic object for the same input, so the fix is to (1) route naked PS scripts through /decode/smart on the Auto-Investigate flow OR (2) attach ps_semantic.analyze(script).to_dict() to every chain in the /auto-investigate response, mirroring the change already applied in /app/backend/routers/ops.py::/decode/smart.
